bio.text: Gilbert Cisneros was born and raised in Southern California and enlisted in the U.S. Navy in 1989, receiving a Navy ROTC scholarship and a commission as an officer in 1994.
He was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives from California's 39th District in 2018.
In 2021 he was appointed by President Biden as Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness and was sworn in on August 24, 2021.
In November 2024 he was elected to the House again, from California's 31st Congressional District, and he holds a B.A. in political science from George Washington University.
